goal: Make the harness pass the default per-grader wall-clock timeout through to command graders so a grader command that hangs is killed and recorded with a timeout termination under the default config, instead of blocking validation forever.

relevant: packages/flywheel-core/src/flywheel_core/harness.py -- around line 3422 run_command_graders is called WITHOUT per_grader_timeout_seconds; the default ceiling must be passed here

packages/flywheel-core/src/flywheel_core/grader_command.py -- run_command_graders already accepts per_grader_timeout_seconds (line ~101) and records payload['termination']='timeout' (line ~188); reuse it, do not re-implement
constraints: Resolve the default per-grader timeout from the prerequisite config and pass it into run_command_graders from the harness; do not re-implement the timeout in grader_command.py.
Under default config (no explicit per-grader timeout argument) a hanging grader command must be killed and recorded with payload['termination']=='timeout'.
An operator override (including unbounded/0 opt-out) must still be honored.
Add the pytest target so `uv run pytest -k command_grader_default_timeout` selects it; assert through the harness's default call path, not just the parameter in isolation.
Commit the change with a clear message before reporting done.
non_goals: Do not modify or weaken assertions in test_grader_command.py.
Do not change the agent, rubric, docker, or autopilot paths here.
Do not alter the existing termination discriminator semantics (exited|signal|timeout).
edge_cases: A command grader whose `run` blocks (sleep-style) under DEFAULT harness config fails with termination=='timeout' in bounded wall time.
A fast-passing command grader still passes (no false-positive timeout).
The override path still bounds (or opts out of) the per-grader timeout.
